NAME: SLIDE_KERNEL_PAGE_SETUP_ATTEMPTS
BASIS: Bounds retries of slide controlled-page setup; a positive but inadequate cap can prevent path completion.

NAME: FOPS_KERNEL_PAGE_SETUP_ATTEMPTS
BASIS: Bounds retries of fops controlled-page setup; a positive but inadequate cap can prevent path completion.

NAME: FOPS_ROUTE_COARSE_DELAY_USEC
BASIS: Selects coarse placement within a required ordering window.

NAME: FOPS_ROUTE_FINE_DELAY_TICKS
BASIS: Selects the fine sweep around the required ordering window.

NAME: DEFAULT_EXPLOIT_ATTEMPTS
BASIS: Supervisor retry cap; it does not define a successful child result but limits opportunities.

NAME: DEFAULT_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_SEC
BASIS: Supervisor terminates an attempt at expiry.

NAME: DEFAULT_P0_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_SEC
BASIS: Supervisor terminates a pre-P0 attempt at expiry.

NAME: SLIDE_WAIT_NSEC
BASIS: Wait duration participates in establishing the required waiter state and can cause path failure.

NAME: SLIDE_REQUEUE_ARM_USEC
BASIS: Delay participates in required requeue ordering and can cause path failure.

NAME: SLIDE_KSNITCH_APPENDED_FUTEXES
BASIS: Candidate population must be large enough for discovery but consumes environment-defined resources.

NAME: SLIDE_KSNITCH_REPEAT_MEASUREMENT
BASIS: Measurement count controls discovery signal stability.

NAME: SLIDE_KSNITCH_AVERAGE
BASIS: Averaging controls discovery noise and threshold separation.

NAME: SLIDE_KSNITCH_SCREEN_REPEAT
BASIS: Screening repeat count controls early candidate retention and rejection.

NAME: SLIDE_KSNITCH_SCREEN_AVERAGE
BASIS: Screening average controls early candidate separation.

NAME: SKB_SEND_SIZE
BASIS: Determines allocation and fragment geometry used by multiple consumers.

NAME: SKB_RECLAIM_SENDS
BASIS: Controls reclaim coverage under allocator state.

NAME: SLIDE_RECLAIM_SENDS
BASIS: Controls slide-stage reclaim coverage under allocator state.

NAME: P0_FINGERPRINT_MIN_BEST
BASIS: Acceptance floor protects against accepting weak matches and can also safely reject true matches.

NAME: P0_FINGERPRINT_MIN_MARGIN
BASIS: Winner separation protects against ambiguous identification and can also safely reject true matches.
